title: Search endpoint
prompt: Implement query parameters for product search.

starter.content:
def search(q: str | None = None, limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100)):
    return {"q": q, "limit": limit}

expected_output: Query filters are optional and result count is bounded.

hints: Read the linked lesson and identify the smallest endpoint/model/dependency needed.
